questions.question: In King Josiah's day, while money was brought out of the LORD's house, what did the priest Hilkiah find?
King Josiah sent men to ask the LORD about the law book. Which prophetess did they go to?
The prophetess Huldah said the LORD would bring calamity on Judah. What reason did the LORD give?

answers.text: They forsook Him and burned incense to other gods
They let His house fall apart for many years
They turned to Egypt for help in their battles

questions.question: After the law book was read to him, King Josiah made a covenant before the LORD. What did he promise?

answers.text: To follow the LORD and keep His commandments
To rebuild the walls around every city
To send priests out to every nation
